description: Canonical persona, journey, user-story, flow, screen, component and diagram coverage for the complete PenniLogic Android, customer-web and admin products. Records are planning contracts and use synthetic data only. Schema version 2 migration of the frozen planning import named in imported_from; values marked as DesignOps proposals await owner confirmation.

screens.name: App lock and privacy gate
screens.security_reason: Application lock and privacy gate in front of all on-device financial data; it protects local access only and is not a substitute for server authentication. Basis: T-TRU-01 lock and screen-protection requirements; T-UXA-13 least-disclosing defaults.

screens.name: Register and sign in
screens.security_reason: Registers and signs in the account holder with passkeys and device-bound sessions; failures must not reveal whether an account exists or which factor failed. Basis: ADR-019 passkeys and sessions; T-AND-01 and T-UXA-02 security requirements.

screens.name: Channel verification
screens.security_reason: Verifies a contact channel; channel re-verification is one of the two ADR-019 recovery routes and verifying a channel on an established account is a step-up operation. Basis: ADR-019 sections 9, 10 and 12; T-AND-01; T-UXA-02.

screens.name: Recovery entry and code
screens.security_reason: Starts account recovery with a recovery code or channel proof; it must reveal nothing about whether an account, channel or code exists. Basis: ADR-019 section 10 recovery; T-AUTH-02 and T-UXA-02 security requirements.

screens.name: Recovery cooling off
screens.security_reason: Shows a pending recovery during its cooling-off window, while credential changes and new sessions are delayed and the recovery can still be cancelled. Basis: ADR-019 section 11 cooling-off periods; T-AUTH-02.

screens.name: Credential reenrollment
screens.security_reason: Re-enrols a passkey after recovery or device loss, a credential change governed by the ADR-019 step-up, recovery and young-credential rules. Basis: ADR-019 sections 9 to 11; T-AUTH-02 lost-device and re-enrolment journey.

screens.name: Purpose consent
screens.security_reason: Records or declines purpose consent before personal data is processed; no analytics event may fire before its purpose is consented and a refusal stays private. Basis: T-CMP-02 consent requirements; T-UXA-02 permission denial remains private.

screens.name: Age eligibility
screens.security_reason: Age gate deciding whether onboarding may continue to the processing of personal financial data; no screen may expose account existence. Basis: T-CMP-02 pre-onboarding consent and age gate; T-UXA-02 security requirements.

screens.name: Permission dashboard
screens.security_reason: Shows and changes every optional data-source permission; denial or revocation of one must not reduce unrelated functionality. Basis: T-CMP-02 permission dashboard; ADR-004 raw content stays on the device; T-UXA-02 permission denial remains private.

screens.name: SMS permission rationale
screens.security_reason: Explains and requests SMS read access for on-device parsing; raw message content never leaves the device and denial must not reduce unrelated functionality. Basis: ADR-004; T-UXA-02 permission denial remains private.

screens.name: Notification access setup
screens.security_reason: Grants notification-listener access for on-device capture; raw notification text never leaves the device and denial or later revocation must not reduce unrelated functionality. Basis: ADR-004; T-UXA-02 permission denial remains private.

screens.name: Capture health
screens.security_reason: Shows each capture source's permission and health, including denied and revoked access, and where capture is stopped or granted again. Basis: ADR-004; T-UXA-06 source permission scope and revocation are explicit.

screens.name: Mailbox connector
screens.security_reason: Connects or revokes mailbox access for on-device statement parsing; mailbox consent is a distinct, independently revocable purpose and raw email never leaves the device. Basis: T-ING-01 security requirements; ADR-004; T-UXA-06.

screens.name: Receipt camera
screens.security_reason: Requests camera access for receipt capture in context; its purpose is recorded in the consent ledger and images stay in private storage outside device backup. Basis: T-ING-02 security requirements; T-UXA-06 source permission scope is explicit.

screens.name: Family grants
screens.security_reason: Creates, changes and revokes per-member, per-category household grants; access is default-deny, revocation is immediate and cached shared data is evicted. Basis: ADR-005; ADR-019 section 9 step-up for grant changes; T-FAM-03 and T-UXA-10.

screens.name: Household dashboard
screens.security_reason: Shows other members' shared data under active grants, a detail-level cross-user read that is logged, visible to the data subject and evicted on revocation. Basis: ADR-005; ADR-019 section 11 window-restricted reads; T-FAM-06 security requirements.

screens.name: Cross-user access log
screens.security_reason: Subject-scoped log of who accessed the user's shared data, with revocation through the single server revocation path. Basis: ADR-005 detail access is logged and visible to the subject; T-TRU-04 security requirements.

screens.name: Safe exit and concealment
screens.security_reason: Discreet safe exit and rapid concealment for coercive situations; exit leaves no residual grant and a duress unlock cannot be told apart from an ordinary one. Basis: ADR-005 unilateral revocation; T-TRU-05 and T-FAM-03 security requirements.

screens.name: AI history and provider settings
screens.security_reason: Manages assistant history and the AI provider key or custom endpoint that decides where prompts are sent; adding or replacing either is a step-up operation. Basis: ADR-022 AI egress and custom endpoints; ADR-019 section 9; T-UXA-11 backend-only provider routing.

screens.name: Trust and consent centre
screens.security_reason: Trust and consent centre where purposes are reviewed and withdrawn and protections are disclosed; it must never claim a protection the evidence does not support. Basis: T-TRU-02 and T-TRU-01 security requirements; T-UXA-13 least-disclosing defaults.

screens.name: Export deletion rights
screens.security_reason: Data export and account deletion, both ADR-019 step-up operations; deletion is crypto-shredding and shared data follows the multi-subject erasure rules. Basis: ADR-019 section 9; ADR-006; ADR-021; T-TRU-02 export and deletion require step-up and rate limits.

screens.name: Debt progress widget
screens.security_reason: Home-screen widget that shows debt progress outside the application lock; it must be opt-in, least-disclosing and immediately removable. Basis: T-AND-08 and T-UXA-15 widget privacy requirements.

screens.name: Split invitation acceptance
screens.security_reason: Accepts a split-group invitation link that grants membership and visibility of group expenses; links expire and cannot be used to enumerate users. Basis: ADR-005 split groups; ADR-019 section 9 step-up for acceptances; T-SPL-02.

screens.name: Household invitation review and acceptance
screens.security_reason: Reviews and accepts a household invitation that grants cross-user data access; grants are explicit, never implicit or whole-household. Basis: ADR-005; ADR-019 section 9 step-up for acceptances; T-FAM-03; T-UXA-10.

screens.name: Profile security and active sessions
screens.security_reason: Account security settings for credentials, channels, recovery codes, devices and active sessions, whose changes are ADR-019 step-up operations. Basis: ADR-019 sections 8 to 11; T-AND-01; T-AUTH-02.

screens.name: Web register sign in
screens.security_reason: Web registration and sign-in with passkeys and bound sessions; responses and timing must not reveal whether an account exists. Basis: ADR-019; T-UXW-01 and T-WEB-01 security requirements.

screens.name: Web verification recovery
screens.security_reason: Web channel verification and account recovery; nothing may reveal whether an account, channel or code exists and recovery follows the cooling-off rules. Basis: ADR-019 sections 10 and 11; T-UXW-01 security requirements.

screens.name: Full export deletion
screens.security_reason: Full data export and deletion, the highest-value target for a stolen session; both are step-up operations with rate limits and expiring export delivery. Basis: ADR-019 section 9; ADR-006; ADR-021; T-WEB-02 security requirements.

screens.name: Family grants
screens.security_reason: Web management of household grants: default-deny, per-category grants, instant revocation and cached-data eviction. Basis: ADR-005; ADR-019 section 9 step-up for grant changes; T-FAM-04 security requirements.

screens.name: Household dashboard
screens.security_reason: Shows other members' shared data under active grants, a detail-level cross-user read; revoked data is evicted across tabs and never persisted unencrypted. Basis: ADR-005; ADR-019 section 11 window-restricted reads; T-FAM-07.

screens.name: Family access and exit
screens.security_reason: Web access review, revocation and safe exit for household sharing; revocation is immediate and clears cached shared data. Basis: ADR-005 unilateral revocation; T-FAM-04 security requirements; T-UXW-07.

screens.name: AI history provider settings
screens.security_reason: Manages assistant history, bring-your-own keys and custom endpoints that decide where prompts are sent; key material stays in the encrypted gateway path. Basis: ADR-022; ADR-019 section 9 step-up; T-AIP-04 security requirements.

screens.name: Trust consent centre
screens.security_reason: Web trust centre for consent, transparency, analytics opt-out and privacy mode; the transparency view is subject-scoped. Basis: T-TRU-03 security requirements; T-UXW-10 access events reveal no hidden resource.

screens.name: Rights export deletion
screens.security_reason: Web export, deletion and rights requests; export and deletion are step-up operations and erasure follows the crypto-shredding and multi-subject rules. Basis: ADR-019 section 9; ADR-006; ADR-021; T-TRU-03; T-UXW-10.

screens.name: Split invitation acceptance
screens.security_reason: Accepts a split-group invitation link that grants membership and group expense visibility; no design may grant implicit or group-wide access. Basis: ADR-005 split groups; ADR-019 section 9 step-up for acceptances; T-SPL-04; T-UXW-07.

screens.name: Household invitation review and acceptance
screens.security_reason: Reviews and accepts a household invitation that grants cross-user data access; no design may grant implicit or group-wide access. Basis: ADR-005; ADR-019 section 9 step-up for acceptances; T-FAM-04; T-UXW-07.

screens.name: Purpose consent and age eligibility
screens.security_reason: Web purpose consent and age eligibility before processing; no dark pattern, bundled purpose or inferred consent, and refusal reveals no account existence. Basis: T-WEB-05 security requirements; T-UXW-01.

screens.name: Profile security and active sessions
screens.security_reason: Web account security settings for credentials, channels, recovery codes, devices and active sessions, whose changes are ADR-019 step-up operations. Basis: ADR-019 sections 8 to 11; T-UXW-01; T-WEB-01.

screens.name: Operator sign in session
screens.security_reason: Operator sign-in in the separate administrative identity domain; the console holds no credential beyond the operator session and never sees key material. Basis: ADR-020 administrative boundary; ADR-019; T-ADM-04 security requirements.

screens.name: Role aware console shell
screens.security_reason: Role-aware, default-deny console navigation: an absent capability is neither rendered nor addressable and redaction is the default of every screen. Basis: ADR-020; product/08 section 8; T-ADM-04 and T-UXM-01 security requirements.

screens.name: Redacted case access
screens.security_reason: Operator request for access to a customer case whose values are masked by default; unmasking follows the approved path and the subject sees the access. Basis: ADR-020 masked-by-default reads and unmask path; T-ADM-15; T-UXM-02 subject-visible events.

screens.name: Elevation bulk approval
screens.security_reason: Approves time-bound elevation and bulk export with requester and approver separation, subject notification and immutable audit. Basis: ADR-020 elevation and four-eyes controls; T-ADM-15 fails closed on audit or notification failure; T-UXM-02.

screens.name: Break glass ceremony
screens.security_reason: Break-glass emergency access to customer data with provenance, expiry, subject notification and immutable audit; it fails closed when audit or notification fails. Basis: ADR-020 break-glass governance; T-ADM-15; product/08 section 8.

screens.name: Operator roster
screens.security_reason: Shows which operators hold which administrative roles, the basis of every operator access decision, with minimum operator data and no customer data. Basis: ADR-020 role model and administrator lifecycle; T-ADM-14; T-UXM-03.

screens.name: Joiner mover leaver
screens.security_reason: Joins, moves and removes operators and their roles; an offboarded identity becomes absent rather than disabled with access. Basis: ADR-020 administrator lifecycle; T-UXM-03 and T-ADM-14 security requirements.

screens.name: Qualification recertification
screens.security_reason: Recertifies or revokes the operator qualifications that make an operator eligible for sensitive queues and actions. Basis: ADR-020 approver eligibility and recertification; T-UXM-03 and T-ADM-14 security requirements.

screens.name: AI provider registry
screens.security_reason: Registry of the AI providers that may receive user prompts; provider keys are referenced by identifier only and are never displayed, exported or accepted. Basis: ADR-022 AI egress; T-ADM-08 and T-UXM-05 security requirements.

screens.name: AI routing spend kill switch
screens.security_reason: Routes assistant traffic between providers, enforces spend caps and stops egress with a kill switch; expired evidence disables routing rather than warning. Basis: ADR-022 AI egress and kill switches; T-ADM-08; T-UXM-05.

screens.name: Support case account status
screens.security_reason: Operator view and change of a customer's account status, including suspension; every lookup is recorded against the operator and ticket and redaction is the default. Basis: ADR-020; T-ADM-09 security requirements; T-UXM-06.

screens.name: Rights request action
screens.security_reason: Operator fulfilment of a customer's rights request, such as export or erasure, under a separate default-deny role with no direct data-store access. Basis: ADR-020; ADR-006; ADR-021; T-ADM-13 security requirements.

screens.name: Refusal completion evidence
screens.security_reason: Records the completion or refusal of a rights request with its evidence; exports stay in the user-controlled delivery path and a missing statutory profile fails closed. Basis: ADR-020; ADR-021; T-ADM-13 and T-UXM-07 security requirements.

screens.name: Audit chain review
screens.security_reason: Read-only review of the administrative audit chain that records operator reads and effects; records reference sensitive material by identifier only. Basis: ADR-020 audit streams; T-ADM-11 security requirements; T-UXM-08.

screens.name: Access anomaly monitoring
screens.security_reason: Monitors operator access for anomalies across customers; suppression and rate-limit controls are visible and cannot be bypassed. Basis: ADR-020 audit streams and anomaly detection; T-ADM-11; T-UXM-08 security requirements.

screens.name: Aggregate analytics
screens.security_reason: Aggregate analytics with server-enforced cohort minimums; it never accepts a user identifier, so per-user analysis and differencing stay impossible. Basis: T-ADM-10 security requirements; T-UXM-08; ADR-020.

screens.name: Standing access inventory
screens.security_reason: Inventory of standing production access, which must hold no standing human access outside the governed broker. Basis: ADR-020 standing access and broker; T-ADM-16 and T-UXM-09 security requirements.

screens.name: Broker session approval
screens.security_reason: Approves brokered production-access sessions; no reusable credential or query result is displayed and subject notification and audit correlation are visible. Basis: ADR-020; T-ADM-16 and T-UXM-09 security requirements.

screens.name: Restore scrub barrier review
screens.security_reason: Reviews restored data behind a scrub barrier before any access; only statement fingerprints and counts are shown. Basis: ADR-020; ADR-006 crypto-shredding holds for backups; T-ADM-16 and T-UXM-09 security requirements.

screens.name: Operator account recovery
screens.security_reason: Recovers an operator account in the separate administrative identity domain, a privileged authentication path. Basis: ADR-020 administrative boundary; ADR-019 recovery; T-ADM-04; T-UXM-01.
